ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface area with a ratio of approximately 85% high-intensity pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at edges and central markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity dark-grey/black border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Distinctive low-intensity dark geometric cluster resembling an 'A' or 'H' shape located at the central base of the fluke. Sparse, low-intensity focal spots (mottling) distributed across the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate calculated pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits fine-grain, low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge features high-amplitude macro-serrations, including one deep, distinct rectangular notch approximately mid-way between center and tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping outward and upward to slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed dark-grey circular pixel clusters across the white ventral field, with higher density on the interior of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major acquired notch is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe. A distinctive, high-contrast dark pigmentation mark shaped like a capital letter 'A' is present at the junction of the peduncle and fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'A-shaped' central mark at the base of the fluke serves as a highly unique diagnostic visual anchor.
